entries.20c3d81fae1076ec: Based on accumulated marketing data and market research, it considers the appeal points of products and the ad media to use, and also proposes improvements to client companies' landing pages. The products supported are selected from those that have large room for sales growth after test marketing.
entries.233c9f0f801b9fe4: The company creates ads in-house and, at its own expense, places display ads and search ads on web media such as LINE, Yahoo!, Google and Facebook. It has strengths in using display ads suited to reaching latent audiences.
entries.275ce154efed7ada: A business carried out by consolidated subsidiary Oramu Tech Co., Ltd., mainly involving the purchase and sale of products in the beauty, health and lifestyle fields. In addition, targeting companies that have excellent products but face challenges in their sales structures and channel development, it takes integrated responsibility from sales strategy planning through channel development to building and running logistics and operations. As the general distributor in Japan for the JOVS brand of home beauty devices, it built a sales structure and launched a new product in January 2026. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended June 2026 was ¥492 million.
entries.49c38cb5bc26038a: A business that consistently supports client companies, from building marketing strategies through ad production to ad operation, for their products and services. The group bears advertising costs to acquire new users and receives revenue-share fees from client companies according to the number of users acquired. Because client companies do not need initial fees or consulting fees, small and mid-sized companies that have difficulty securing budgets are also eligible for support. In the fiscal year ended June 2026, revenue from external customers was ¥16,687 million, making this the core business that accounts for most of consolidated revenue.
entries.4d608ba7a4ffcfe3: For the ads it places, it runs large numbers of A/B tests on appeal points, creatives and delivery methods, rapidly repeating hypothesis building, execution, verification and improvement to maximize marketing effectiveness. It also has its own ad review system to confirm compliance with advertising-related laws and regulations.
